decisions.recommendation: Require source, jurisdiction, scope, verification time, expiry, and dispute state; never equate account type with authority
decisions.policy: Professional clinical authority shall require current, scoped, source-attributed evidence and shall not arise from account type, appointment, payment, or document upload.

decisions.recommendation: Adopt explicit classes for canonical health facts, provider source records, private notes, facility execution, owner observations, and derived projections
decisions.policy: Health records shall be classified by source, purpose, authorship, continuity obligation, and disclosure class before storage or projection.

decisions.recommendation: Require jurisdiction-specific registry, licensed authority where applicable, enhanced audit, dose/unit validation, and fail-closed conflicts
decisions.policy: Controlled or legally restricted treatment shall not be ordered, represented, administered, or reconciled without the applicable governed authority and enhanced evidence controls.

decisions.recommendation: Permit minimum necessary welfare escalation within founder-approved limits, preserve contact attempts, separate care authority from expense liability, and require later review
decisions.policy: Emergency welfare action shall remain distinct from durable treatment authority and financial responsibility.

decisions.recommendation: Keep private deliberative notes source-retained by default; transfer verified horse-health facts and active care information through classified projection
decisions.policy: Private or deliberative notes shall not transfer merely because the horse transfers; continuity shall use an approved, source-attributed projection.

decisions.recommendation: Include minimum necessary verified active-care and safety facts, preserve source documents and restrictions, and permit dispute annotation
decisions.policy: A health continuity package shall prioritize verified active safety and care needs while excluding unrelated private or restricted information.

decisions.recommendation: Display source/rule version and evidence state; prohibit guaranteed compliance or eligibility unless authoritative confirmation exists
decisions.policy: EquineSync shall not guarantee competition, medication, withdrawal, regulatory, or governing-body compliance from stored data alone.

decisions.recommendation: Fail closed, quarantine conflict, show uncertainty, block unsafe next-dose confirmation, and require authorized reconciliation
decisions.policy: Conflicting or stale offline medication state shall not be auto-merged into authoritative administration truth.

decisions.recommendation: Preserve raw source and quality metadata; treat as evidence until verified or professionally interpreted
decisions.policy: Imported or device-generated data shall not become verified clinical judgment solely through ingestion, transformation, or model interpretation.

decisions.recommendation: Require separate purpose, authority, de-identification risk review, retention, opt-out/withdrawal policy, and no default model training
decisions.policy: Clinical and welfare data shall not be used for model training or unrelated research by default.

decisions.recommendation: Permit policy-based minimum care and qualified escalation with neutral records, limits, notices, and review
decisions.policy: Owner unreachability or suspected neglect may support narrow welfare-preserving action but shall not establish guilt, ownership, or unlimited spending authority.

decisions.recommendation: Require verified decision authority, licensed involvement where required, enhanced audit, respectful restricted visibility, and no automation
decisions.policy: Euthanasia and end-of-life decisions shall require accountable human authority and shall never be made or approved by AI or unattended automation.

decisions.recommendation: Permit supervised minimum-necessary task instructions and observations; deny private clinical, owner, financial, and dispute records
decisions.policy: Minor access to horse-health information shall be limited to the minimum necessary for safe, authorized participation.

decisions.recommendation: Limit to retrieval/summarization and explicitly authorized low-risk support with citations, uncertainty, and qualified human review; prohibit diagnosis/prescription/execution
decisions.policy: AI clinical support shall remain non-authoritative, source-grounded, uncertainty-labeled, and incapable of diagnosis, prescription, treatment selection, or execution.
